subject: ACME RFP: audit log retention, exportability, and extraction details
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@acme.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: security_ops@acme.com, procurement@acme.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ACME RFP: audit logs and retention questions (attached)

Hi Connor,

Thanks for the quick intro call yesterday. As part of our procurement/RFP process we have a short focused questionnaire on logging, audit trails, and data exportability. Please see the attached spreadsheet (ACME_RFP_Log_Questions.xlsx) — we marked a handful of must-have items for legal and our security team.

High-level asks:
- Do you capture per-request audit logs (who, when, model version, input hash)?
- Retention windows and options for customer-controlled retention policies
- Mechanisms for exporting logs for customer audits (format, APIs, bulk export cadence)
- Encryption and redaction options for PII in logs

Can you provide a written response and any sample artifacts (schema, sample export CSV, policy PDF) by EOD tomorrow? Security will triage and may ask follow-ups. If helpful we can schedule a 30m follow-up with our security engineers.

Thanks — Emily
Emily Park
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme, Inc.
emily.park@acme.com

Attachment: ACME_RFP_Log_Questions.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12kb)

From: connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@acme.com>
Cc: ava_chen@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACME RFP: audit logs and retention questions (attached)

Hi Emily — thanks for sending these over and for the clear must-haves. Looping in Ava (security/product) and Markus (sales lead) to provide the technical responses and artifacts.

Proposed plan:
1) Ava will populate the XLSX with matrix answers and attach a sample export and our retention policy PDF.
2) Markus will provide SOC-2/Security summary and confirm timelines for any contract-level changes.
3) If you want live walk-through, happy to schedule a 30-minute technical review tomorrow (Wed) afternoon — suggest 1pm PT.

Quick answers inline to the must-haves (high-level):
- Per-request audit logs: yes, we generate request-level audit records including timestamp, request_id, API key tag, model version, token counts, and a SHA-256 input hash (we do not store raw input by default in shorter retention modes — see policy).
- Retention controls: default 90 days for hosted accounts, can be configured for longer retention under Dedicated/Private plans; we also offer a customer-managed retention policy for Private deployments.
- Exports: we support both ad-hoc API export and bulk daily/weekly exports to S3-compatible endpoints; exports use CSV/NDJSON schemas.
- PII handling: logs are encrypted at rest; we offer field-level redaction and an opt-in DLP integration for sensitive detection.

Ava — can you confirm specifics (schema sample and redaction options) and attach the evidence?

Thanks,
Connor
Ariel "Connor" O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@acme.com>, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 14:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACME RFP: audit logs and retention questions (attached)

Emily / team — responding with the technical matrix and attached artifacts. See answers below and the two attachments: redwood_audit_log_schema.csv and redwood_retention_policy.pdf.

(Answers correspond to the rows in your spreadsheet)
1) Audit record contents (we maintain the following fields by default):
   - event_ts (ISO8601), request_id (UUID), api_key_id (obfuscated), customer_id, user_agent, model, model_version, prompt_token_count, completion_token_count, response_hash (SHA-256), latency_ms, routing_path, region
   - We also log tool/function calls surfaced by the SDK when enabled.

2) Retention windows and policy options:
   - Hosted: default 90 days (configurable to 30/60/90). For customers requiring longer retention, Dedicated offers retention up to 3 years configured at onboarding.
   - Private (on-prem/VPC): retention fully customer managed via local storage policy and KMS controls.
   - We can provide contract addenda for custom retention SLAs for enterprise purchases.

3) Export mechanisms and formats:
   - Ad-hoc API: /v1/admin/logs/export supports filters (time range, request_id, customer_id) and returns NDJSON or compressed CSV bundle.
   - Scheduled bulk: daily or weekly export to customer S3 (or S3-compatible) with manifest file; retention of export bundles is customer-controlled in their bucket.
   - For very large datasets, we support snapshot exports (parquet) on request — typical turnaround 2-3 business days.

4) Encryption, masking, and redaction:
   - All logs encrypted at rest with customer-specific KMS keys for Dedicated/Private. Hosted uses server-side encryption with customer-supplied keys possible via KMS integration.
   - Field-level redaction: we can remove or hash specified fields (e.g., prompt_hash only, or hash plus remove prompt_preview).
   - PII detection: opt-in DLP runs on logs before export; matches can be redacted or replaced with tokens.

5) Access controls and audit of the audit logs:
   - RBAC + token-scoped audit for internal console access; all accesses to logs are themselves audited.
   - We retain an immutable access audit trail for 2 years (configurable for Dedicated/Private).

Attachments included: redwood_audit_log_schema.csv (sample row + field descriptions); redwood_retention_policy.pdf (formal policy summary).

If you want, I can produce a small sample export (7 days) with synthetic anonymized rows to demonstrate the schema — say 24 hours to produce.

Emily: would you like us to populate your XLSX directly with these answers? We can return it as a filled spreadsheet if that speeds procurement.

Regards,
Ava Chen
Senior Product Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.ai

Attachments:
- redwood_audit_log_schema.csv (attachment stub; CSV, 6kb)
- redwood_retention_policy.pdf (PDF, 48kb)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@acme.com>, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACME RFP: audit logs and retention questions (attached)

Emily — thanks for the quick review and thanks Ava/Connor for the detailed responses. I reviewed the artifacts and approve sharing the SOC-2 summary for your security team's review. Attaching SOC2_summary.pdf and adding two quick commercial notes:

- Dedicated plan: can accommodate bespoke retention up to 3 years and supports customer-managed KMS; pricing is in the ARR addendum (we can share upon NDA).
- Contract language: we accept reasonable retention and export clauses; for unusual export SLAs (e.g., weekly encrypted push to on-prem appliance) we'll include a technical annex.

Would you like us to return the filled spreadsheet and a synthetic export sample? We can do both and schedule a 30-minute technical walk-through tomorrow at 1pm PT.

Markus Klein
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

Attachment: SOC2_summary.pdf (PDF, 120kb)
